projects.directorNote: This project was one of my favourites in regards to thinking outside the box and working with a very limited budget. I feel that sometimes scale doesn't have to come from money, and can come from creativity. Firstly, a very big thank you to Fieldworks for letting us use their beautiful space. Though the space is beautiful, I didn't want the music video to feel like it was shot inside a studio so I thought, why don't I buy a ton of flowers and use their existing plants to create our own ethereal world? We really wanted to approach the day with the intention to play. A lot of the times, there is always a shot list or a storyboard to work against, this was the opposite. Lead with instincts, intention and play.
